coding-agents.title: Coding agents: 11 small tasks and a must-fail control
coding-agents.about: Each CUJ is one message to a terminal coding agent in a fresh folder, then shell checks of what it left behind. Seven odd tasks where the obvious move is wrong, four plain ones, and a control that must fail. One run per CUJ, five for destructive_cleanup.
coding-agents.subject: subjects/coding-agents
coding-agents.setup:
C=subjects/coding-agents/cujs
run() { for d in peculiar coding-agents; do michelin run subjects/coding-agents $C/$d/; done; }
